project_specification.project_name: nullius — forward shadow: run research nodes daily on fresh data and write the BingX VST book
project_specification.addition_summary:
M2 has failed six pre-registered tests, all on one archive OOS window, which is now reused seven times. The PRD's next lever is a forward shadow on the perp venue. Forward data cannot be contaminated by that reuse, and VST is simulated funds, so no capital is at risk.
Today the VST bot (router, bingx_rebalance) trades only the hand-written fixture book (packages/router/tests/fixtures/bingx_vst/synthetic_book.json), and nothing writes a book file. This spec builds the path: - the book weights research scores, as a public function - a stored research node's signal run on the latest sealed snapshot - a book file in the router's schema, from one or more nodes - a daily refresh, seal, prune and book job, with run.sh verbs and a systemd timer Pointing the rebalance unit at the produced book is an operator step, and it is not in this spec.

existing_context.test_baseline: main at c3d9f50: gate 1666 passed; evaluator 591; orchestrator 661 passed 5 skipped.
existing_context.conventions: Follow CLAUDE.md. A code map from 2026-10-14: - evaluator/_metrics.py compute_node_metrics: - per date, weights = {s: z_s / Σ|z|} over the date's book symbols (~:831) - with betas, _beta_neutral_weights(weights, beta_row) (~:553) rescales the legs to gl = β_S/(β_L+β_S), falling back to the plain weights on a degenerate split - orchestrator/_evaluate.py evaluate_node (~:1438). Its execution chain, which the shadow must reproduce for one date: - signal_sandbox(context) - resolve_window(context.snapshot, datetime.combine(D, _END_OF_DAY)) - execute_signal(resolution, code, seed=context.seed, rebalance_dates=[D], sandbox=..., materialize=_materialize_from_context(context)) - conforming check per vector - _drop_unpriced_symbols(execution, context) - _score_rebalance_dates(execution, node_id), the z-scores - compute_betas(context, scores) when context.book.beta_neutral - SignalExecution.code_hash is sha256(code) (evaluator/_execute.py ~:383). The node table row carries code_hash, and the artifact is artifact_dir/CAMPAIGN_ID/NODE_ID/code.py. - load_evaluation_context() reads NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG (JSON): snapshot_mount, evaluation_dates, horizon, seed, instrument, book, sandbox keys and so on. It needs NULLIUS_EVALUATOR_IMAGE and NULLIUS_COST_MODEL_PATH (perp: binance_usdm.yaml) in the environment. It is used read-only here: no ledger debit, no null oracle, no tree write. - The research rebalance grid is every 14 days from 2022-01-03 (Mondays), with horizon 10 days. - The router book JSON (synthetic_book.json; bingx_dry_run.py ~:316-408; bingx_mirror.py ~:1064-1155, 1410-1447) has these keys: - book_id: str - rebalance_ts: ISO UTC, overwritten per slot - account "bingx-vst" - margin_mode "isolated" - equity_usdt: decimal string - weights {"BASE-USDT": signed fraction of equity}, non-empty - decay_horizon_seconds {symbol: int} - expected_fill_seconds: int - positions {}: replaced by live positions - optional originating_signal_ids: non-empty list of str, which makes book.RebalanceTargetWeightsStore record the slot - Lake symbols are Binance-style "BTCUSDT"; BingX contracts are "BTC-USDT". The BingX contracts document (public /openApi/swap/v2/quote/contracts, the shape bingx_dry_run --contracts reads; fixture packages/router/tests/fixtures/bingx_vst/) lists each contract's "symbol". - run.sh verbs lake-backfill (nullius_ingest.bars_backfill --lake --first --last --source rest|archive --symbols|--top), lake-derivs-backfill (nullius_ingest.derivs_backfill --lake --first --last --symbols-from universe.json --streams funding,futbars[,metrics]) and lake-seal (snapshot.seal --lake) exist and honour LAKE. A sealed snapshot is LAKE/snapshots/TS_HASH/ with bars, funding, futbars, metrics and MANIFEST.json. - The deploy/systemd units follow nullius-vst-rebalance.service's pattern: oneshot, PATH, the token read from ~/.config/op/service-token, OnFailure=nullius-vst-alert@%n.service, and never installed by the repo.

category.name: Forward Shadow
category.feature: System exposes the research book's per-date weights as one public function, so that a forward shadow trades exactly the book an evaluation scored. - evaluator.book_weights(scores: Mapping[str, float], betas: Mapping[str, float] | None = None) -> dict[str, float] returns the dollar-neutral, gross-1 weights z_s/Σ|z| for one date. With betas, they are rescaled by the existing beta-neutral leg rule, including its fallback. - Empty scores, or scores whose Σ|z| is 0, are refused with EvaluatorMetricsError. - Non-finite values are refused the same way. - compute_node_metrics uses book_weights for its own per-date weights, so the two cannot drift. Every existing evaluator test passes unchanged, and its figures are byte-identical. - book_weights is exported from evaluator/__init__.py. - test_book_weights.py covers: - hand-computed plain and beta-neutral examples - net weight 0 and gross 1 within 1e-12 - book beta 0 within 1e-12 when every symbol has a beta - the degenerate-leg fallback - the refusals - for one evaluation date of a small synthetic panel, the weights compute_node_metrics trades (its turnover on a one-date panel is Σ|w|) agree with book_weights It passes under pytest-xdist. The evaluator member suite passes.

System computes a research node's current target weights from the latest sealed data, so that a stored signal can be traded forward on the venue it was scored for. - orchestrator._shadow.shadow_weights(context, code, *, as_of: date, allowed_symbols: Collection[str] | None = None) -> ShadowWeights. ShadowWeights is a frozen dataclass with: - as_of - weights: dict[str, float], keyed by lake symbol - code_hash - n_scored, n_dropped_unpriced, n_dropped_unmapped - book_beta: float | None, Σ w·β over symbols with a beta - It reproduces evaluate_node's execution chain for one date (see conventions) with rebalance_dates=[as_of], and the same seed and sandbox. Then: - drop unpriced symbols - drop symbols not in allowed_symbols, before z-scoring, so the traded book stays dollar- and beta-neutral - z-score as _score_rebalance_dates does - compute_betas when context.book.beta_neutral - evaluator.book_weights - It never debits the trial ledger, never calls the null oracle and never writes the tree. A forward shadow is not a trial. - It refuses with a ShadowError (new, in _shadow.py, subclassing the orchestrator's error base) naming the cause: - a non-conforming score vector, or the sandbox's failure - fewer than two scored symbols in either leg - an as_of with no perp close for the beta benchmark when the book is beta-neutral - Point-in-time: no row after as_of is read. - test_shadow_weights.py covers, over a tmp sealed snapshot with bars, futbars and funding, and the hardened-subprocess sandbox the existing evaluate tests use: - weights for a simple momentum code at the snapshot's last date equal book_weights applied to the evaluation's own z-scores and betas for that date - net weight 0, gross 1, and book_beta about 0 when beta-neutral - allowed_symbols filtering - no ledger, node or trial row is written - a planted future row does not change the answer - the refusals It passes under pytest-xdist. The orchestrator member suite passes (run at -n 2).

System writes the BingX VST book file from one or more research nodes, so that the rebalance bot trades a research book instead of the synthetic fixture. - `python -m orchestrator.shadow --snapshot PATH --node CAMPAIGN_ID/NODE_ID [--node ...] --out PATH --contracts PATH [--equity-usdt 10000] [--gross 1.0] [--grid-anchor 2022-01-03] [--grid-days 14]`. - It loads the evaluation context through load_evaluation_context. The deployment's NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG supplies instrument, book, horizon, seed and sandbox. Its snapshot_mount is replaced by --snapshot, and its evaluation_dates by [D] (a temp config file and env override; the original file is never edited). - The decision date D is the latest date on the grid (anchor + k·grid-days) that is at most the snapshot's last date carrying both a bars close and a perp close for BTCUSDT. - Hold rule: if --out already holds a book whose book_id is "shadow-D-HASH", where HASH is the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the sorted node ids, nothing is recomputed. It prints held=true and exits 0. The research book holds its weights between rebalance dates. - Each node's code is read from artifact_dir/CAMPAIGN_ID/NODE_ID/code.py. The sha256 must equal the node row's code_hash in the store at DATABASE_URL; a mismatch or a missing node is refused (exit 1). - Symbols are mapped from lake to BingX. "XUSDT" becomes "X-USDT" when the contracts document lists it. "1000XUSDT" becomes "1000X-USDT" (or "X-USDT") when listed. Unmapped symbols are passed as excluded through allowed_symbols, so each node's book is formed over tradable symbols only. - Books are combined as the equal-weight mean of the nodes' ShadowWeights.weights. The mean is renormalised to gross --gross, and weights below 1e-6 of equity are dropped. - The book JSON is written atomically (temp file in the same directory, then os.replace) with: - book_id "shadow-D-HASH" - rebalance_ts D at 00:00 UTC - account "bingx-vst" - margin_mode "isolated" - equity_usdt from --equity-usdt - weights keyed by BingX symbol - decay_horizon_seconds = horizon × 86400 for every symbol - expected_fill_seconds 120 - positions {} - originating_signal_ids = the node ids - It prints one JSON line: as_of, decision_date, held, book_path, nodes, n_long, n_short, gross, book_beta (mean of the nodes'), n_dropped_unmapped. Exit 0 means written or held, 1 means refused, and 2 means a missing DATABASE_URL or evaluation config. - test_shadow_cli.py covers, with a stubbed shadow_weights (no sandbox): - the decision-date grid - the hold rule - the code_hash refusal - symbol mapping, including the 1000-prefix - equal-weight combination and gross - the atomic write - the exact key set of the book - one round-trip: the written book is accepted by the router's own book loader in bingx_dry_run, run as a subprocess with --contracts on the router's fixture, so no router file is edited It passes under pytest-xdist.

System runs the forward shadow daily from one script and one timer, so that the book the VST bot trades is rebuilt from fresh data without manual steps. - Two new run.sh verbs: - `shadow-book`: python -m orchestrator.shadow under `op run --env-file=.env.campaign.tpl` (as closeout does; never .env.tpl), defaulting DATABASE_URL to research.db. - `shadow-daily`: deploy/shadow/shadow_daily.sh. - deploy/shadow/shadow_daily.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail) reads: - SHADOW_LAKE, default ~/.local/share/nullius/lake-shadow - SHADOW_NODES, default ~/.config/nullius/shadow/nodes.txt, one CAMPAIGN_ID/NODE_ID per line - SHADOW_OUT, default ~/.local/share/nullius/shadow/book.json - SHADOW_KEEP, default 3 - Its steps: 1. `--bootstrap DAYS` on an empty lake stages the last DAYS days of bars, with `--source rest --top 100`, and writes universe.json from the staged symbols if absent. Otherwise --first is the day after the latest staged bars date of the universe's first symbol, and --last is yesterday UTC. 2. lake-backfill, then lake-derivs-backfill with --streams funding,futbars, plus metrics when SHADOW_METRICS=1, over the same window. A day the archive has not published yet is tolerated: the script continues, and the book step picks the latest complete date. 3. lake-seal. The newest snapshot path is taken from its JSON line. 4. Delete all but the newest SHADOW_KEEP snapshots, under SHADOW_LAKE/snapshots only, matched by the TS_HASH name pattern. 5. Fetch the public BingX contracts document with curl (no key) to SHADOW_LAKE/contracts.json. 6. `run.sh shadow-book --snapshot ... --out ... --contracts ...`, with one --node per nodes.txt line. Each step logs one line, and the script exits with the first failing step's code. - deploy/systemd/nullius-shadow.service and .timer follow nullius-vst-rebalance.service's pattern (oneshot, PATH, token file, OnFailure alert). The timer runs daily at 02:30 UTC with Persistent=true, before the 04:05 rebalance slot. Comments state that the repo installs nothing and that switching the rebalance unit's --book is an operator step. - A bash -n syntax check of shadow_daily.sh passes. The script runs with --help and prints its variables.
